environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in AWS VPC. The order-service container is deployed in the 'commerce' namespace on ECS with AWS App Mesh (Envoy sidecar). The API Gateway forwards requests with X-User-Id header but no additional authorization enforcement. App Mesh virtual service allows all traffic from any virtual node. No network policy restricts inter-service communication. The ALB target group routes directly to the Fargate task on port 8080.
